view: 2014 and 2024 photos present six wide window strips per side, and one narrow window strip beside each central entrance pier. The published 2021 general description counts five; adopt the visible 2024 steel window layout.
measuring_crop: 590 px wide thumbnail derived from the entire width of the 873 px 2024 front image; vertical range [round(564*.20),round(564*.79)].

photo_reference_pixels.north_south_return_note: The source picture faces the grass-facing elevation. Horizontal pixel measurements apply around the central plane.

limits: The camera is almost frontal; the foreground hides footsteps and grade. Upper stone setbacks, depth of piers and absolute heights remain photographic estimates. The government roof oblique controls the rear volume and stepped central lift.
